content.short: Polygon ID uses a decentralized identity system to create trusted interactions with Web3 services.
content.description: Polygon ID enables programmable privacy for Web3 interactions, delivering a decentralized, user-controlled, and privacy-focused experience when engaging with services. It relies on zk-SNARK technology to provide cryptographic protections, helping ensure sensitive data stays private while maintaining secure interactions. The design supports a scalable model for permissionless and censorship-resistant digital identities, empowering users to participate in Web3 without compromising control over their identity information.
content.meta: Polygon ID enables decentralized identity with user-controlled privacy in Web3. Discover Polygon ID and other Identity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
